usedFor: WooCommerce takes orders, and Signable sends the contract when “New Order Created” runs “Send an Envelope using a Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in WooCommerce, then “Send an Envelope using a Template” in Signable
bestTemplate.why: A new order starts the signing paperwork from your saved template without anyone sending it by hand.

watchOut: “Send an Envelope using a Template” reaches a customer outside, so it waits in Needs you for approval.
